description: This file defines functions for configuring CLI11 command-line parser options related to logger application configuration schema, including log level settings and output file options.

methods.name: configure_cli11_log_args
methods.description: Configures CLI11 options for logging parameters, including log level, filename, and hex size, with post-parsing callback to set default log levels.

methods.name: ocudu::configure_cli11_with_logger_appconfig_schema
methods.description: Sets up the 'log' subcommand in CLI11 app and configures logging options using the provided logger_appconfig object.
